content: Mudlet GMCP work should be event-driven: GMCP data lands in the gmcp table, handlers can be attached to gmcp.Char.Items.*, gmcp.Char.Vitals, gmcp.Room.Info, and other events, and modules that do not auto-stream can be requested with sendGMCP. For boop features, this supports table-stakes GMCP state handling, owned domain state, and recovery paths when live events are missing or delayed.
